---
title: "Akkermansia diff check"
author: "Dan Spakowicz"
date: "11/10/2021"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r cars}
x <- read_csv("../data/derived/bewell_akkermansia.csv")
```
```{r}
y <- 
  x %>%
  mutate(BRB = tB - rB,
         Plac = tP - rP) %>%
  select(BRB, Plac) %>%
  gather("treatment", "rel.abun")
```


```{r}
y %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rel.abun)) +
  geom_density(aes(fill = treatment), alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Change in Akkermansia Relative Abundance",
       y = "Density")
ggsave("../figures/Akk-diff-check.png",
       height = 3, width = 5)
```
